Inverse.

examples.text: In einer Gruppe ist das inverse Element eindeutig bestimmt.

glosses: Opposite in effect, nature or order.
Reverse, opposite in order.
Inverted; having a position or mode of attachment the reverse of that which is usual.
Having the properties of an inverse; said with reference to any two operations, which, when both are performed in succession upon any quantity, reproduce that quantity.

examples.text: Multiplication is the inverse operation to division.

glosses: That has the property of being an inverse (the result of a circle inversion of a given point or geometrical figure); that is constructed by circle inversion.

examples.text: A circle inversion maps a given generalized circle to its inverse generalized circle.

glosses: Whose every element has an inverse (morphism which is both a left inverse and a right inverse).
An inverted state: a state in which something has been turned (properly) upside down or (loosely) inside out or backwards.

examples.text: Cowgirl is the inverse of missionary.
321 is the inverse of 123.

glosses: The result of an inversion
The reverse of any procedure or process.

examples.text: Uninstalling is the inverse of installation.

glosses: The result of an inversion
A ratio etc. in which the antecedents and consequents are switched.

examples.text: The inverse of a:b is b:a.

glosses: The result of an inversion
The result of a circle inversion; the set of all such points; the curve described by such a set.

examples.text: The inverse P‘ of a point P is the point on a ray from the center O through P such that OP × OP‘ = r² or the set of all such points.

glosses: The result of an inversion
The non-truth-preserving proposition constructed by negating both the premise and conclusion of an initially given proposition.

examples.text: "Anything that isn't a dog doesn't go to heaven" is the inverse of "All dogs go to heaven." More generally, ¬ mathsf p→¬ mathsf q is the inverse of mathsf p→ mathsf q and is equivalent to the converse proposition mathsf q→ mathsf p.

Inversion is the inferring, from a given proposition, another proposition whose subject is the contradictory of the subject of the original proposition. The given proposition is called the Invertend, that which is inferred from it is termed the Inverse... The rule for Inversion is: Convert either the Obverted Converse or the Obverted Contrapositive.

glosses: A second element which negates a first; in a binary operation, the element for which the binary operation—when applied to both it and an initially given element—yields the operation's identity element, specifically:
The negative of a given number.

examples.text: The additive inverse of x is -x, as x-x=0, as 0 is the additive identity element.

glosses: A second element which negates a first; in a binary operation, the element for which the binary operation—when applied to both it and an initially given element—yields the operation's identity element, specifically:
One divided by a given number.

examples.text: The multiplicative inverse of x is x⁻¹, as x×x⁻¹=1, as 1 the multiplicative identity element.

glosses: A second element which negates a first; in a binary operation, the element for which the binary operation—when applied to both it and an initially given element—yields the operation's identity element, specifically:
A second function which, when combined with the initially given function, yields as its output any term inputted into the first function.

examples.text: The compositional inverse of a function f is f⁻¹, as ff⁻¹= mathit I, as mathit I is the identity function. That is, ∀x,f(f⁻¹(x))= mathit I(x)=x.

glosses: A morphism which is both a left inverse and a right inverse.
The winning of the coup in a game of rouge et noir by a card of a color different from that first dealt; the area of the table reserved for bets upon such an outcome.

examples.text: If the player... be determined to try his luck on the inverse, he must place his money on a yellow circle, or rather a collection of circles, situated at the extremity of the table.
The tailleur never mentions the words ‘Black’ or ‘Inverse’, but always says that Red wins or Red loses, and that the colour wins or the colour loses.

glosses: A grammatical number marking that indicates the opposite grammatical number (or numbers) of the default number specification of noun class.
To compute the bearing and distance between two points.
Qui est opposé, par rapport à l’ordre, au sens, à la direction actuelle ou naturelle des choses.

examples.text: L’arrangement de ces livres ne me plaisait pas, je les ai disposés dans un ordre inverse, dans l’ordre inverse.
Tourner en sens inverse, dans le sens inverse.
Les objets sont réfléchis dans l’eau en sens inverse.
Prendre la direction inverse.

glosses: Relativement à un élément donné, se dit d'un autre élément qui lorsqu'il est composé avec le premier par une loi de composition interne donne l'élément neutre de cette loi ; symétrique, opposé.
Dont le produit par le nombre en question est 1.

examples.text: Le nombre inverse de cinq peut s’écrire ,1/5, ou ,2/(10),, ou deux dixièmes sous forme décimale, puisque 0,2×5=1.

glosses: Se dit d’un théorème, d’un problème, d’une proposition dont les termes sont dans un ordre inverse par rapport à ceux d’une autre proposition, etc.

examples.text: Si une fonction f inversible est dérivable et de dérivée non nulle, la fonction inverse f⁻¹ est dérivable et l’on a : […].
Dans la proposition inverse, l’attribut de la proposition directe est mis à la place du sujet.
Trois est à six comme six est à douze est la proposition inverse de six est à trois comme douze est à six.
L’intensité de la lumière est en raison inverse des carrés de la distance du corps lumineux, Elle diminue dans le même rapport que ces carrés croissent.
Tous les fous sont méchants est la proposition inverse.

glosses: Le contraire ; l’opposé.

examples.text: Les hommes ne valaient pas mieux avec des pantalons moulants et leur nuque longue, coiffés comme des hommes d'affaires devant mais comme des fêtards derrière, ou parfois l’inverse.

glosses: Relativement à un élément donné, autre élément qui lorsqu'il est composé avec le premier par une loi de composition interne donne l'élément neutre de cette loi ; symétrique, opposé.
Se dit d'un nombre relativement à un autre si le produit des deux vaut 1 (élément neutre de la multiplication).

examples.text: L’inverse de 2 est un demi, sous forme de fraction : ,{1/{2

glosses: Faire l’inverse, Reprendre une opération, une action accomplie, mais dans l’ordre, dans le sens, dans la direction contraire.

examples.text: Faites l’inverse de ce que vous avez fait.
Faire tout à l’inverse. Faire le contraire de ce qu’on attendait, de ce qui était prescrit.
